name: @eeyzs1/dsh-llm-transport-recovery
description: Two-phase recovery for DeepSeek TRANSPORT failures: 5 normal HTTP/1.1 retries within a 2-min window, then a recovery path (fresh DNS + all-IP fallback + brand-new connections, losing candidates aborted) up to a bounded budget (5+15=20 total), then the turn fails like stock DSH. Phase is tracked per session; user cancels never count toward the switch. Compaction gets bounded auto-retry re-dispatched through the full llm/stream chain. The fetch wrapper and its agent are fully reversed on plugin stop/update. The connect budget bounds ONLY the TCP/TLS connect phase, so slow servers are not killed before they respond. Logs full error chains.
